sin.name: inertia-bypass
sin.description: A frontend file sends a request with fetch, around Inertia: its answer is no page and its errors never reach the page's props.
sin.rule: Never bypass Inertia (user message 13525): read through the page's props and a partial router.reload({ only: [...] }), and change through router.post/put/delete to the page's own action routes.
